title: fix(plugin-grid): skip the fill-in pre-read when the edited column cannot open the dialog
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_
Fixes #36025

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表用户在有「条件必填」字段的对象上改单元格时:改动与该条件无关的列,保存前不再多等一次读取请求;改条件相关的列,弹窗照旧。
- 属于「列表内联编辑补填必填项」那条线的收尾优化,替所有在列表里改数据的用户省掉一次无用请求。
- 出错的话,某次本该弹出的补填对话框可能不弹,保存交给服务端判定并给出拒绝提示;改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/fields` gains `requiredWhenPromptAsksOn(objectFields, changedKeys, { fillable })`: whether writing those keys can make `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` ask for anything, judged on metadata alone. It reuses the operand harvest `requiredWhenPromptReads` already uses (`collectPredicateFieldRefs`, `record.x` / `data.x` / `previous.x`), plus one walk over the engine's own parse (`parseCelToAst` from `@objectstack/formula`) for what a harvest cannot name.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s cell prompt (`ask` in `objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx`) asks it before the pre-read: when the edited column cannot open the dialog, the commit goes straight to the next question (the state confirm) with no `findOne`. Rows that lack no key, and hosts with no `read`, are unchanged.
- The read stays for every column when an askable field's `requiredWhen` reads the clock (`now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow()`, `daysAgo()`) or the acting user (`current_user`, `user`, `ctx`, `os` roots), per the card's ruling; and also when it reads the record as a whole (`record["stage"]`, `size(record)`), does not parse, or is in another dialect, because its operands cannot be listed.
- Measured exception to the card's premise: an askable field that is ALSO statically `required: true` is asked for on any commit while it is empty (`resolveFieldRuleState` answers `required` from the static flag whatever the predicate says). Skipping its read would have changed what the user sees, so such a field keeps the read for every column; pinned on both layers.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts`: a new top-level describe for `requiredWhenPromptAsksOn`, including the premise itself (for an unrelated key the collector asks nothing whatever the record holds), the operand spellings, clock and user roots, whole-record / unparseable / other-dialect, the static-required exception, the askable narrowing, and a record field named `user`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.requiredPrompt-35956.test.tsx`: a new top-level describe in the existing harness: (a) committing a column no predicate reads sends no `findOne` and saves at once; (b) committing an operand reads once and the dialog opens as before; (c) a clock predicate and a user predicate keep the read; (d) a statically required field still opens the dialog on an unrelated column.

<details><summary>Readings at 7bc608a4</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/src/requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.requiredPrompt-35956.test.tsx` (root `ui/`, under the verify lock): Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 42 passed (42), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation of pin (a), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, deleting the gate line in `ask` (anchor x1 to x0, blob 69b41ffe12b0 to 9910829062a5): Tests 1 failed / 15 passed (16), the one red is "committing a column no predicate reads sends no findOne, and the change saves at once"; restored, blob == HEAD 69b41ffe12b0, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject resolves through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` source alias, so no `dist` leg applies.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed: a field carrying both `required: true` and `requiredWhen` is asked for in the list dialog on any cell commit while it is empty, which this PR keeps unchanged. Whether the engine would refuse that commit was not measured.
- The user half of the ruling is inert on this surface today: the prompt evaluates `requiredWhen` with no acting user bound, so a user-reading predicate faults to not-required. The read is kept for it anyway, as ruled.

## Verification

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`: `requiredWhenPromptAsksOn` and `readsBeyondNamedFields`, the judgment the skip rests on.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx`: the one gate line in `ask`, placed after the no-read branch.

Two-minute check: from the repo root, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.requiredPrompt-35956.test.tsx`; expect 16 passed, including "committing a column no predicate reads sends no findOne".

Local gates: the 39 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff, reconciled with `--ran` (39 accounted, 38 run, 1 NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt`, exit 3, its closure build never got the shared lock). `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, the package `type-check` of both packages and their full `test` runs are NOT MEASURED locally (the shared verify lock timed out repeatedly); CI's Type Check UI, Test UI and Lint & Repo Gates carry them.
